title: Sum of the digits
hints: `n % 10` is the last digit of `n`, and `n // 10` is `n` with the last digit chopped off.
Take `abs(n)` first. Then, `while n > 0:`, add the last digit to a total and chop it off. The loop ends when nothing is left.
`n = abs(n)`, `total = 0`, `while n > 0: total += n % 10; n //= 10`, then `return total`
